text.tspan: Includes overlays painted directly each frame, over the cached content: origin cross,
ruler, selection rectangle, cursor, scene rect marker and the optional gray-out
tint. They follow the mouse and tool state, so they are never cached.

text.tspan: Scene items: traces, pads, vias, planes, text and so on. These are rendered onto
transparent pixels and stored in the cache ring. A pan reuses these pixels;
zoom and content changes re-render them. This is the only layer the cache

text.tspan: Includes the background color and grid. Painted each frame from the view and grid
settings, so changing them never invalidates the cache. Areas the cache has not
rendered yet will show background and grid only.
